content.title: Designed Ellipsis | Visible Buildup, Authored Interruption, Aftermath
content.summary: Establish two original clearly adult-scale opposing figures and one stable confrontation geography. Escalate through at least three fully visible action beats, then at the maximum threshold deliberately replace the picture with an unmistakably authored original interruption card or graphic blackout. Do not depict, describe or infer the missing action. During the ellipse, use only restrained temporal evidence such as distant sound, rain or a counter. Return to the same geography and reveal only observable aftermath states of the same figures and environment.

quick_start.input_format: Establish two clearly adult-scale original figures and stable geography before escalation. + Show at least three complete visible action beats before the interruption. + Use an unmistakably authored original interruption card at the maximum threshold. + Never depict, narrate or infer hidden action during the interruption. + Return to the same geography and reveal only observable aftermath states.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open in an original industrial test kitchen: two clearly adult rival chefs face opposite stainless stations under one visible countdown lamp; establish knives, ingredients and the center service hatch. Both adults reach for the lids at the same instant and the countdown lamp turns red. Tighten toward the handles but stop before either lid opens. Return to the exact kitchen geometry. Smoke has settled, two finished original plates sit at the hatch, both same adults remain at their stations and no winner is explained. Hold the observable aftermath only; no source fighters, armor, alley or CENSORED wording.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish two original clearly adult-scale opposing figures and one stable confrontation geography. Escalate through at least three fully visible action beats, then at the maximum threshold deliberately replace the picture with an unmistakably authored original interruption card or graphic blackout. Do not depict, describe or infer the missing action. During the ellipse, use only restrained temporal evidence such as distant sound, rain or a counter. The reusable mechanism is legible buildup, explicit authored censorship-as-ellipsis, non-invention and aftermath reveal—not the source fighters, armor, alley, rain palette, CENSORED word, choreography, hidden content, creator identity or timing.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source red-coated fighter, armored opponent, faces, costumes and body designs
source Kowloon-like neon alley, rain, signs and haze
source strikes, blocks, weapons and exact choreography
source black CENSORED cards and exact interruption timing
source anamorphic camera, Seedance 2.5 thread claim and creator identity
